en: I'm painting the view from the lookout, from memory. It's harder than it sounds.
text: Pictez priveliștea de la belvedere, din memorie. E mai greu decât pare.

en: When I was young, Aspertia was a handful of houses. Now look at it: a school, a Gym, the lot!
text: Când eram tânăr, Aspertia era o mână de case. Priviți acum: o școală, o Arenă, de toate!
